Walgreens Nears Sale of Boots Pharmacy Chain for Nearly £7 Billion

Walgreens is nearing a deal to sell its British pharmacy chain, Boots, for approximately £7 billion. The billionaire Issa family, which owns the Primark brand, is reportedly the leading contender to acquire the company. The sale marks a significant transaction in the retail pharmacy sector.
